business: hithozha -- a Tamil-first app for booking hyper-local in-person services (home repair, tutoring, beauty/wellness, event services) in Tamil Nadu
by_segment: Small business owner needing recurring local services
why_not: I don't know this app from anywhere -- no one in my building or my WhatsApp groups has used it, and you're asking me to put my card into something brand new just to save a bit on the freelancer's cut. Urban Company already takes care of the verification headache for me, so the 5% fee pitch doesn't move me when the thing I actually worry about is who's holding my payment details.

I'll download it because I always try the new local apps first, but downloading isn't booking -- I'm not letting someone into my home or handing a kid over to a tutor just because an ad looked slick. I'd want to know people near me are actually using it.

I already have a guy I call for plumbing, an AC man, a tailor -- people I've used for years or my neighbours vouched for. An app full of strangers, however verified, is not going to beat that overnight.

My WhatsApp group already tells me who is good for this kind of work -- a neighbour vouches and that is enough for me. I do not open some new app to book someone for a repair or a tuition class, Tamil or not.
why_yes: Naan JustDial-la rendu moonu number call pannitu than aalu edukuven, but pathi per phone eduthadhe illa, fake listing dhan. Idhula identity verification iruku nu sonnudhadhal, oru try edukalam nu nenaikiren, konjam risk kammi irukum nu feel aguthu.
The 5% fee instead of 25% and having it in Tamil are real pluses, so I'd try it once for something low-risk like a home cleaning, but that's as far as I'll go on a first try.
flip: If a few people I actually know -- in Tamil, not some English review on the website -- had used it and gotten their money back cleanly when something went wrong, and if I could pay via UPI on completion instead of upfront.
